_note: Descriptive event study on 1-minute bars, not a backtest and not a walk-forward (owner 2026-11-10: bots on minute data; is there alpha in the books about it?). Everything below is fixed before any minute bar is looked at. DATA: Binance USDT-M 1m klines (public archive) for 20 liquid perps, 2026-05 to 2026-10; first half (May-Jul) and second half (Aug-Oct) are reported separately and an idea only counts if BOTH halves agree in sign with |t| > 3 (t computed on daily means, so intraday clustering does not inflate it). SIGNALS (library source): A flow continuation: k-min taker imbalance z-score |z| > 3 vs its trailing 7 days, k in {5,15,60}, direction = sign of flow (bouchaud-farmer-lillo, toth, valtos delta). B absorption: same flow extreme but price did not move with it over the window (valtos, tradingriot CVD divergence). C sweep / swing failure: bar trades through the prior 240-min high or low and closes back inside, direction = fade (tradingriot SFP); and its opposite, a close beyond the level, direction = follow. D leader-lag: BTC 1-min and 5-min return beyond 4 sigma, direction = BTC's, measured on the other 19 coins (alexander-heck price discovery). E breadth extreme: at least 90% of coins up (or down) over 15 min with the market move beyond 3 sigma, direction = the move (maxdama cumulative TICK, which the book fades). F activity spike: 1-min volume above 10x its trailing-day mean with a return beyond 3 sigma, direction = the move (maxdama traffic analysis). G extreme move: a coin's 5-min return beyond 4 sigma, direction = fade (liquidation cascades; tradingriot). H hour-of-day seasonality of the equal-weight market (maxdama calendar effects). HORIZONS: forward return over 1, 5, 15, 60 minutes from the close of the signal bar, in bp, signed by the stated direction. BAR TO CLEAR: a taker round trip costs about 12 bp on Binance (2 x (5 bp fee + ~1 bp slippage, measured on our fills)) and about 11 bp on Hyperliquid. An idea is worth a real backtest only if its signed forward return exceeds 15 bp at some horizon in both halves.
